messages:
acme-oncall: hey @sara-support we started seeing a lot of schema validation errors on our webhook after switching to strict json. started ~10m ago. example error: "invalid type for 'user_id' - expected string, got number". webhook id: wk_345. stack trace attached? (paste below)

sara-support: sorry about that — can you paste the original model response body and the schema you sent to the API? quick question: are you using `json_mode: strict` or `json_schema`? :eyes:

acme-oncall: we set `json_mode: strict` in the call. schema expects `user_id` as string. here's model response (trimmed):
```
{"user_id": 123456, "status": "active"}
```
request payload (annotated):
```
POST /v1/responses
{"input": "Extract user info: ...", "json_schema": {...}, "json_mode": "strict"}
```

sara-support: thanks. that response explains the parse error — model returned a bare number for user_id. Can you also provide model name & exact request_ts? we'll try to repro.

acme-oncall: model=redwood/open-compat-v1, request_ts=1958641987, customer_request_id=job-9982

mike-ml: adding context — some models will emit unquoted numerics when the training data favors raw numbers. In strict JSON mode we validate types literally, so this will fail. Short-term workaround: add a prompt instruction forcing quotes, or set `json_mode` to non-strict/coercive. Longer-term: we should sanitize server-side on parse failure.

alex-eng: I can repro locally with the same prompt+model — showed `user_id` unquoted. Logging suggests generation has pattern `^\d+$` and not quoted. Opening ENG-ML bug: RINF-5213. @mike-ml can you take ownership? I'll attach minimal curl for repro:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/responses \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"input": "extract id", "json_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"user_id":{"type":"string"}}}, "json_mode":"strict"}'
```

infra-bot: Created ticket RINF-5213 in eng-ml queue (priority P2) — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-5213 :robot_face:

mike-ml: I'll investigate model variant and whether tokenizer normalization or decoding settings cause numeric tokens to be emitted without quotes. Possible fixes: 1) Post-parse sanitizer for numeric->string coercion behind a feature flag 2) Update model instruction templates to wrap numbers in quotes 3) Add `stringify_numbers` field in API to force stringify before validation.

sara-support: for immediate unblock, customer can either: a) set `json_mode` to `coerce` in the request, b) add "pattern": "^\\d+$" to schema to allow digits explicitly as strings, or c) run a tiny post-processor to stringify numeric ids. Which would you prefer? :slightly_smiling_face:

acme-oncall: we'll flip to `coerce` for now and add a post-processor. please keep us posted on RINF-5213. thanks!

alex-eng: noted. follow-up: we'll roll a patch to add a server-side opt-in sanitizer. assigning to @mike-ml. closing loop when RINF-5213 updated.
